name: trace_to_zmod_nondegenerate
statement: Type*) [Field F] [Finite F] [Algebra (ZMod (ringChar F)) F] {a : F} (ha : a ≠ 0) : ∃ b : F, Algebra.trace (ZMod (ringChar F)) F (a * b) ≠ 0

name: algebraMap_trace_eq_sum_pow
statement: algebraMap K L (Algebra.trace K L x) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (Module.finrank K L), x ^ (Nat.card K ^ i)

name: algebraMap_norm_eq_prod_pow
statement: algebraMap K L (Algebra.norm K x) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (Module.finrank K L), x ^ (Nat.card K ^ i)
